links.comparator_used: ChatGPT standard question versus simplified question (default prompt with no simplification instruction)
links.outcome: Readability (FRES) and information quality (DISCERN) of ChatGPT answers
links.effect: Mean FRES 38.9 pre-simplification vs 55.1 post-simplification; simplified information 43.6% more readable (FRES) but scored 11.6% lower for quality. Readability remained poor.
links.tradeoff: Simplification came at the expense of quality, giving shorter answers with important omissions.
links.quote: Simplified information from ChatGPT was 43.6% more readable (FRES) but scored 11.6% lower for quality.
